opening.argument: The presentation promotes an apparently easy path to passive ETH income through a flash-loan arbitrage bot, while directing viewers to supply ETH for the contract’s operations and fees. It expressly links deployment with earning passive income and recommends funding the smart contract with at least 0.5 ETH for arbitrage and fees. The demonstration then instructs viewers to send one ETH to an address and reports an increase from one ETH to 1.3 ETH. That claimed return is presented as the result of the method, but the available record does not independently establish that the transfer or increase was genuine.
